p0.title: No executable H67 100-record recurrence with bounded SRAM latency and producer cost
p0.finding: The two clean directed groups use an always-ready one-cycle response server and prebuilt descriptors. The observed 1.7x and 2.586956x therefore exclude M228 mask construction, active-chunk walk, group boundaries, finite-latency SRAM occupancy and the exact 100-record ordering. They are real service-island observations but are not FC1 trace speedups.
p0.required_close: Drive the exact M225/H67 100-record descriptor stream through an executable recurrence or RTL wrapper with parameterized fixed SRAM latency and finite credits. Charge active nonempty chunks, descriptor issue, first fill, response bubbles, replay, drain and all existing M225 overheads; publish per-record min/mean/max and aggregate F1/F2/F4.

p0.title: Throughput/area port cut omits fanout-scaled bank plumbing and all macros
p0.finding: The 14592-bit accumulator capacity is excluded, and the TB supplies bank[acc_update_context] for free. DC port counts rise by exactly 3652 pins for every added fanout slot: 1824 read bits + 1824 write bits + 3 context bits + 1 valid bit. Thus the 8-bank read select/write demux or bank-local placement/routing cost is outside the synthesized cone. M228 presence/sign state, weight SRAM capacity/decoder/768-bit port, latency and energy are also absent. Island-only 1.289819x/1.319676x throughput/area cannot be promoted to physical PPA.
p0.required_close: Synthesize a matched eight-bank accumulator adapter with identical 14592-bit capacity, real read/write enable and mux/demux topology for F1/F2/F4; bind characterized SRAM or a sealed area/energy macro table. Integrate the M228 producer state and the same 768-bit weight SRAM interface/latency before rerunning DC/PT/SAIF-PTPX.

p1.finding: VCS uses only three deterministic groups and one in-order one-cycle response queue. Out-of-order legal responses, latency greater than one, response bubbles and randomized trace replay are not covered.
The wrong-identity attack changes source only. Wrong slot, tag, epoch, duplicate response, response-before-request and zero-latency same-cycle response are not individually covered.
Done backpressure, full-queue pop+push at the same physical slot, reset while busy and last-descriptor boundary composition are not directed cover points.

The DC screen is ideal-clock, ZeroWireload and macro-free. F1 setup receipt is only +0.0025 ns and all hold receipts round to 0.0000 ns; F4 has 75 logic levels and logs high-fanout timing warnings. It is feasibility evidence, not routed timing margin.
No mapped-netlist equivalence/Formality, gate-level VCS, PT STA or SAIF/PTPX has been sealed.

The production contract remains conservatively admission.vcs=false, admission.dc=false and admission.throughput_per_area=false after the runs. The evidence can be independently admitted at service-island level, but the formal admission metadata is stale.

The DC top evidence_manifest seals three submanifests and RUN_COMPLETE only; input_sha256.txt, preflight_sha_checks.txt and runner_sha256.txt are not members of that top manifest. Current hashes all match and this independent review seals them, but the production exact-seal chain is not self-contained.

p2.finding: cp_fault reports seven sticky-fault cycles for three attacks, not seven distinct fault classes; receipt wording must keep attacks=3.

ap_update_stable asserts stability of acc_read_data, which is an environmental input. This is useful in directed simulation but should become a wrapper guarantee or formal assumption at the external bank boundary.

DC ignores the unsupported synthesis-time initial $fatal geometry guard (VER-104). Exact runner parameters prevent drift here, but synthesis fail-closed geometry should also be enforced by runner checks or generate an elaboration error accepted by DC.
Response backpressure is not represented: every legal response is unconditionally ready. This is acceptable for a fixed-latency SRAM contract only after that contract is explicit and executable.

positive_findings: All 175 VCS SHA256SUMS entries and all four DC top-manifest entries independently rehash with zero mismatch; current DC/VCS input and runner receipts also match.
F1/F2/F4 each compile and simulate with return code 0, 64 descriptors, 276 context updates, three attacks, nonzero request/update stalls and zero numeric or conservation fatal.
Full four-credit occupancy, request/update overlap, full fanout, request stall, update stall, fault and done all have nonzero cover matches for every fanout.

Clean M229 cycles equal replay beats plus four fill/drain cycles per group for all fanouts. This directly demonstrates that M227's two non-update cycles per source are no longer serialized into steady-state service.
Wrong response source is rejected, Acc19 overflow suppresses update acceptance and sets sticky fault, and INT8 signed add/sub is checked lane-by-lane against an independent TB reference.
Matched DC uses the same RTL, SDC and TCL with FANOUT as the only elaboration parameter. All three postcompile check_design/check_timing reports are clean and 3 ns setup/hold are reported MET.

required_next_gate.name: M230 trace-executable bank-complete closure
minimum_actions: Build the sparse active-chunk/generation-valid M228-to-M229 descriptor producer so zero chunks are skipped without broad clear.
Replay all 100 frozen H67 FC1 records with fixed SRAM latency sweep and four-credit occupancy, preserving record order and reporting cycle components.
Add an explicit eight-bank Acc19 adapter and identical capacity/macro accounting to all variants; include weight and presence/sign SRAM capacity, ports and energy.
Select F2 or F4 only on trace throughput/area and energy, then run exact VCS, DC, Formality, PT and SAIF/PTPX for that point.
required_next_gate.admission_threshold: No claim above directed service-island scope until both P0 findings close.
